## Selected Work

::: {.project-grid}
::: {.card .fade-in .delay-1}
### Decentralized Multi-Robot Ergodic Planning

First author, RAL (in submission). A unified framework for distributed
multi-robot ergodic exploration of unknown dynamic environments — Bayesian
belief fusion, probabilistic connectivity, and an iLQR solver.

[Read more →](project.html){.btn .btn-ghost}
:::

::: {.card .fade-in .delay-2}
### RL-Adaptive MPC Controller

Project lead. A differentiable MPC controller embedded inside a PPO training
loop, letting reinforcement learning reshape the MPC cost online for robust UAV
flight under disturbed localization.

[Read more →](project.html){.btn .btn-ghost}
:::
:::
